conversion: FreeCAD BREP solids tessellated to STL and referenced by MuJoCo MJCF mesh assets
excluded: prototype tentacle-master parts (represented by placed tentacle instances)

arm_root_frames.local_mesh_frame: translated to arm LCS and rotated so each arm extends along local +X

dynamics.arms: one revolute shoulder hinge per arm; arm geometry itself is rigid
dynamics.actuation: position actuators are numerical placeholders, not pneumatic pressure control
dynamics.collision: simplified ellipsoid and capsule proxies; detailed CAD meshes are visual-only
dynamics.inertial: placeholder values; replace with measured component masses, COMs and inertias
dynamics.fluid: no buoyancy, hydrodynamics, or fluid-structure interaction yet
dynamics.soft_body: not yet a deformable continuum; no chamber inflation or silicone hyperelastic constitutive model
